scope: Authored source and semantic proposals compiled into the real assessment bridge and selector. No arbitrary extraction, semantic validation, learner outcome or history migration is established.

checks.name: Source capture preserves literal text and identical captures are idempotent
A source cannot be silently replaced under the same version
Incorrect quotes and unavailable source versions hold affected targets
Exact source quotes do not resolve a known unsupported claim
The goal selects explanation targets without inventing a timed recall requirement
The connected target includes actual versioned supporting claims without creating learner credit
Missing and conflicting content definitions cannot become a usable contract
An explicit dependency cycle terminates without multiplying references
Coverage with an unknown criterion is held instead of reaching the assessment bridge
Changing the target cannot stamp an old recall prompt as a newly reviewed recognition task
Invalid versions or missing total-cost fields cannot produce runnable exercises
A ready content target with no exercise remains visibly unserved
The new material contract runs a larger task then repairs only its observed connection error
An omitted connection asks for evidence without treating omission as a knowledge failure
The same pipeline accepts a simple fact with one target and one recall
Draft reuse retains both sources, refuses a scope conflict and creates no observation
Reuse versions derived claims instead of mutating the old content identity
Reusing an existing claim cannot erase a flagged source contradiction
Editing a supporting claim holds its transitive dependents and exercises while preserving independent content
Explicit author review makes revised exercises available without rewriting old evidence

math.prompt: Let n=2^k. Stop at size 1 and do constant local work per call. Explain the number of halvings, then compare the total calls with one versus two continuing half-size branches. Justify the difference.

Worked explanation: count every call, not only the depth. One path has k+1 calls; two continuing branches form a full binary tree with 2n-1 calls. Explain why matching depth does not imply matching work.

Two procedures start at n=2^k, stop at size 1 and do constant local work per call. One continues in one half; the other continues in both halves. A colleague says equal depth means equal total work. Evaluate that claim, accounting for every call.

fact.prompt: In the invented vocabulary you studied, what does mavo mean? Answer without a hint.
